create_ObjectInstruction: create an ObjectInstruction dataclass with position, orientation, radii, speed, and body index for MPC control
create_Instruction: create an Instruction dataclass with left and right target body indices and a list of object instructions
run_instruction_cost: run instruction_cost to compute reach and object tracking cost for a MuJoCo MJX model and data state
test_ObjectInstruction_fields: test ObjectInstruction fields including 3D position, 4D quaternion orientation, and per-axis radii
review_instruction_cost: review instruction_cost to compute weighted L2 norm residuals for gripper reach and object pose-velocity tracking
